subject.title: Rally caller (soldier roster v1, horn - replaces the standard axis)

canon.silhouette: a large bare shaved head with no headgear at all and a thick bent horn springing from the mouth, arcing up and to the side, its flared bell clearing the crown entirely - the only curve in the roster and the only object that breaks the outline upward
canon.reads_as: a head with a horn growing out of it - the only shape that breaks the crowd's top edge

prompt.description: A rally caller from the crowd, unarmoured, with a great horn. A large bare shaved skull, no headgear and no brim, an open face with two sunken eyes. A long thick war horn springs from the mouth and sweeps up and away, bending from a diagonal into a near-vertical rise, ending in a wide flared bell with a hard rim well clear of the top of the head. A plain cloth tunic with a single narrow metal strap crossing the chest on a diagonal, a belt, bare legs and dark boots. No weapon at all.
must_include: a large bare shaved head - no helmet, no headgear, no brim
a long thick war horn attached at the mouth, sweeping up and out from the head
the horn bending from a diagonal into a near-vertical rise, not a straight stick
a wide flared bell with a hard rim, ending well above the top of the head
a single narrow metal strap crossing the chest on a diagonal
must_avoid: helmet, skullcap, brim, visor, crest or plume
banner, flag, pennant, standard or any cloth rectangle
spear, sword, club, shield or any weapon
a straight horn or a straight tube - it must bend
a horn held in the hand away from the face
lamp, torch, candle or visible flame
glow, halo, sparks or rays around any pixel
white or near-white highlights, specular glints
large solid black body mass, heavy internal outlining, deep recesses, cast shadow
